title: Residual transpose mate calculation for scalar quotient transition
statement: After transporting the level-m scalar quotient comparison through the completion isomorphism, the residual finite reduction and tensor-square composite has the same normalized-adjunction transpose as the L-side unit, restriction-comparison inverse, counit, and level-n residual quotient composite.

source.place: Paragraphs 3-4, mate calculation after completion naturality

proof.text: Expand the finite reduction comparison and tensor-square residual, then use the defining mate equation of scalarReductionExchange together with the unit and counit triangle identities. The two resulting coefficient restriction composites agree by the scalar quotient square.
